title: Harassment (English)
description: Talkative in English; reports harassment by a manager in the management topic, then answers the deepening questions with facts, by role only. Synthetic.

onboarding: The first two weeks were fine: I had a laptop on day one and a clear reading list from a colleague.
management: My manager harassed me every week in one to one meetings for about a year, and the comments were about my appearance.
growth: Training was available, but my request for a course in my second year was left unanswered for four months.
pay_vs_promises: Pay matched the offer letter, but the review promised after six months only happened after thirteen months.
culture: People mostly avoided conflict, and there was no clear way to report problems.
reason_for_leaving: I left after nine months because I could not keep working under those conditions.

fallback: I do not really have more to say about that.

*: He made the comments in private meetings and then in front of the team on Mondays.
It started within the first months and happened roughly every week for about a year.
It was my direct manager, and a senior colleague who laughed along.
I reported it to HR, and they said it was a matter between colleagues and nothing was changed.
